create_UNetMotionModel: create a UNetMotionModel instance with custom block out channels and attention heads for video generation
build_from_unet2d: build a UNetMotionModel from an existing UNet2DConditionModel by loading weights and adding motion modules
freeze_UNetMotionModel_params: freeze all UNet2DConditionModel weights in UNetMotionModel while leaving motion modules unfrozen for fine tuning
save_motion_modules: save the motion modules from a UNetMotionModel to a directory as a MotionAdapter checkpoint
enable_freeu: enable the FreeU mechanism on UNetMotionModel upsample blocks with custom scaling factors s1, s2, b1, b2
